title: racoon AI provenance manifest (RFC 0005 "provpaws")
description: One manifest per AI-assisted work session. Referenced from commits by the Provenance-Id trailer. Records which models produced output that entered the diff, as declared by the human contributor. Self-reported: model_reported_by states how trustworthy each model field is.

schema_version.description: Frozen per major version. A breaking change creates manifest-v2.schema.json; v1 manifests stay valid forever.

provenance_id.description: UTC timestamp plus random suffix. Must equal the manifest file name stem and the Provenance-Id trailer value.

reviewer.description: The accountable human: e-mail address as used in Signed-off-by, or GitHub handle.

statement.description: pending: written by an agent or before review; verify fails until the accountable human changes it. An AI can prepare the record but never complete the attestation.

digest.description: Digest of a privately kept session log. Proves a log existed without publishing prompts or transcripts.

ref.description: Optional opaque session reference (e.g. a tool session URL). Informational only; may not be resolvable by others.

role.description: Role name as defined in the referenced profile (implementer, reviewer, ...).

model_reported_by.description: api: model id as returned by the provider; config: as configured in the harness; manual: declared by hand.

files.description: Repository paths whose committed content contains output of this contribution. Empty for review-only roles.

family.description: Model family used for the dissimilarity rule (e.g. anthropic-claude, alibaba-qwen).

id.description: Model identifier, or the organisation-managed neutral reference when disclosure is withheld.

snapshot.description: Dated snapshot / build identifier, if the provider exposes one.
